verdict.rationale: Cursor documents account sign-in to its coding agent. The CLI offers a browser authentication flow, ACP clients authenticate via the "cursor_login" method, and the Cloud Agents API is available on all plans with user API keys. The single-device login policy in community reports was a support-bot hallucination that Cursor later retracted, so it does not contradict this. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sign-in draws on the user's subscription plan and its included usage, plan-by-plan agent entitlements, and independent hands-on corroboration of the login flow.
